high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news website. The headline reads: "Steve Jobs email confirms Apple was working on an 'iPhone nano'." Below the headline, there is a subheading that states: "A meeting agenda confirms the existence of an 'iPhone nano'." The author of the article is Jay Peters, and it was published on August 19, 2021, at 10:00 am. The image includes a social media sharing icon at the bottom, with icons for Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn. There is also a section labeled "Full Coverage" at the very bottom
